worldcombat.skill.purify.summary: Reach toward the aim: the combatant aimed at directly is drawn from, and an aim at the ground picks the nearest afflicted combatant within a small radius, drawing every harmful status effect off it at once. Only a real draw sends the affliction back to the user as dark mist and heals the user for a fraction of the target's maximum health. It can purify allies and foes alike, but fails outright when the aimed target is already clean or nothing afflicted is near.
worldcombat.skill.purify.use.0: Cleanse a poisoned ally and heal yourself in one reach
worldcombat.skill.purify.use.1: Take a foe's burn away and turn it into your own life
worldcombat.skill.purify.use.2: Draw from a high-health target to restore more health
worldcombat.skill.purify.description.0: Reach out and draw every harmful status effect off the target (beneficial and neutral effects stay); only a real draw then restores health equal to %1$s of the target's maximum health; the reach is %2$s blocks. The healing depends only on that maximum health, not on how many statuses were drawn.
worldcombat.skill.purify.description.1: A combatant aimed at directly is drawn from; an aim at the ground picks the nearest afflicted combatant within %1$s blocks (ally or foe alike, never the caster). When the aimed target is already clean, or nothing afflicted is nearby, the whole move fizzles.
worldcombat.skill.purify.stance.deep: Deep draw: x1.25 healing, but x1.25 wind-up, x1.15 cooldown, x0.85 capture radius and x0.9 reach (a forceful draw).
worldcombat.skill.purify.stance.light: Light draw: x0.9 wind-up, x0.92 cooldown, x1.15 capture radius and x1.05 reach, but only x0.85 healing (an offhand cleanse).
worldcombat.skill.purify.timing: A point move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast. It cannot move while preparing and can be interrupted.
worldcombat.skill.purify.preference.deep: On: x1.25 healing but x1.25 wind-up, x1.15 cooldown, x0.85 capture radius and x0.9 reach. Off (light draw): faster, easier to catch and further reaching, with x0.85 healing. Each direction has its moments.
worldcombat.skill.purify.preference.ai.h: The companion queues Purify for an ally below this ratio that also carries a status; lower keeps attacking, higher draws as soon as there is hurt and affliction.
worldcombat.skill.purify.preference.ai.s: Below this ratio the companion allows Purify on a foe to trade its affliction for life; lower stays restrained, higher trades at the first loss of health.
worldcombat.skill.purify.preference.ai.e: A foe is only worth drawing from while it carries no more than this many harmful statuses; lower touches only lightly afflicted foes, higher cures foes that are worse off.
worldcombat.skill.purify.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 0.75 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.purify.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 1.7 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
